collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager is restless and cannot sit still today: ask them to help with something heavy, or go for a run.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) can't sit still today. (subject.He/she) doesn't know why. (subject.He/she) has cleaned the hut twice, walked to the stream and back for no reason, sat down, stood up, reorganized (subject.his/her) tools, and is now pacing outside. It's not a bad feeling. It's not a good one. It's just a lot of energy with nowhere to go. (friend) watches (subject.him/her) pace past.

choices.label: Ask (subject.him/her) to Help with Something Heavy

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Want to help me move a log?" asks (friend). (subject) says yes so fast it's almost rude. They move the log. Then another. Then (subject) moves three more on (subject.his/her) own. By evening (subject.he/she) is tired in the best way, and the restlessness has gone, along with a great many logs.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) runs. Along the beach, over the rocks, round the gardens and back. Then again. By the third time round, people are cheering (subject.him/her) on without knowing why. (subject.He/she) collapses on the sand at sunset, out of breath, perfectly calm at last.
